newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle lower as weather fears ease.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle lower as weather fears ease.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled weaker following a late selloff partly prompted by an ease in fears that damaging cold weather could hit Florida's citrus belt, traders and analysts said.
A floor source said late trade selling wiped out the day's slim gains. "But I think the market is close to a bottom here," the source added.
March orange juice futures settled 0.10 cent weaker at 81.50 cents per pound, traded 82.30 to 81.50 cents.
Celeste Georgakis, FCOJ specialist at Dean Witter, said although the market had been oversold, disappointment from the failure to retrace past 82.50 cents in March prompted some selling.
The colder weather forecast for the Florida region and elsewhere was also downgraded, thereby weakening market support.
"We were looking for a cold front similar to December, but I think across the country they moderated the forecast," Georgakis said. "The fundamentals are bearish overall."
